column1: # check-docs.sh: inject a documentation reminder, but only for gh pr create.
#            quiet = nothing is printed at all
#   docs     which directories exist in the sandbox repository for this case:
#            both | arch | adr | none. A fired reminder has to name exactly the
#   repo     code   = the unpushed commit changes app.sh
#            nocode = the unpushed commit changes only README.md
#   command  tool_input.command; \n becomes a newline and \t a tab
# Fields are separated by a single TAB. The hook reads the process working
# directory, so the harness runs it inside the sandbox repository.
# --- another gh subcommand must stay silent ---
# --- the three words have to be tokens, not a substring ---
